concepts.title: Line, Line Segment, Ray
concepts.definition: A line segment has two endpoints. A line has no endpoints (extends in both directions). A ray has one endpoint (extends in one direction).
concepts.formula: segment = 2 endpoints; line = 0 endpoints; ray = 1 endpoint
concepts.key_idea: Segment has 2 ends, line has 0 ends, ray has 1 end.
question_patterns: identify line segment line and ray
how many endpoints does a line have

solution_steps.explain: Check endpoints: 2 = segment, 0 = line, 1 = ray
Name based on number of endpoints
Confirm: segment has 2 endpoints, line has 0 endpoints, ray has 1 endpoint

concepts.title: Complementary Angles
concepts.definition: Two angles are complementary if their sum is 90 degrees. Each angle is the complement of the other.
question_patterns: find the complement of the angle
find angle equal to its complement
difference of two complementary angles is 12

solution_steps.explain: Find the known angle
complement = 90 - given_angle
The complement is the result

concepts.title: Supplementary Angles
concepts.definition: Two angles are supplementary if their sum is 180 degrees. Each angle is the supplement of the other.
question_patterns: find the supplement of the angle
find angle equal to its supplement
larger supplementary angle is 44 more than smaller
can two acute angles be supplementary
can two obtuse angles be supplementary

solution_steps.explain: Find the known angle
supplement = 180 - given_angle
The supplement is the result

concepts.title: Adjacent Angles and Linear Pair
concepts.definition: Adjacent angles have a common vertex and a common arm, with non-common arms on opposite sides. If adjacent angles are supplementary, they form a linear pair.
concepts.formula: adjacent: common vertex + common arm; linear pair: adjacent + sum = 180
concepts.key_idea: Adjacent share vertex and arm. Linear pair sums to 180.
question_patterns: do they form a linear pair
adjacent angles that do not form linear pair

solution_steps.explain: Both angles must share a vertex
Both angles must share one arm
Non-common arms must be on opposite sides
If sum = 180, they form a linear pair

concepts.title: Vertically Opposite Angles
concepts.definition: When two lines intersect, the angles opposite to each other are called vertically opposite angles. Vertically opposite angles are equal.
concepts.key_idea: Opposite angles when lines intersect are equal.
question_patterns: explain vertically opposite angles with an example
short note on vertically opposite angles
why is vertically opposite angles important
give one everyday example of vertically opposite angles
describe vertically opposite angles in your own words
what do you understand by vertically opposite angles
list the main points about vertically opposite angles

solution_steps.explain: Identify where two lines intersect
Angles directly across from each other
Vertically opposite angles are equal

concepts.title: Intersecting Lines
concepts.definition: Two lines intersect if they have a point in common. The common point is the point of intersection.
concepts.formula: intersecting lines share exactly one point
concepts.key_idea: Lines that cross share one point.
question_patterns: can two lines intersect at more than one point

solution_steps.explain: Lines must share a common point
The common point is the point of intersection
Two distinct lines can intersect at exactly one point

concepts.title: Transversal
concepts.definition: A transversal is a line that intersects two or more lines at distinct points.
concepts.formula: transversal intersects 2+ lines at distinct points
concepts.key_idea: A line cutting across two or more lines.
question_patterns: give one everyday example of transversal
describe transversal in your own words
what do you understand by transversal
list the main points about transversal

solution_steps.explain: A transversal must intersect at least two lines
Intersection points must be different
If the line cuts two or more lines at distinct points, it is a transversal

concepts.title: Angles Made by a Transversal
concepts.definition: A transversal creates 8 angles: interior (3,4,5,6), exterior (1,2,7,8), corresponding pairs (1-5, 2-6, 3-7, 4-8), alternate interior pairs (3-6, 4-5), alternate exterior pairs (1-8, 2-7), interior on same side (3-5, 4-6).
concepts.formula: 8 angles: interior, exterior, corresponding, alternate, same-side
concepts.key_idea: Transversal makes 8 angles with special pairs.

solution_steps.explain: Find the transversal and the two lines it cuts
Number the angles in order
Corresponding: same position. Alternate: opposite sides, between lines. Same-side: same side, between lines.

concepts.title: Transversal of Parallel Lines
concepts.definition: If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal: (1) each pair of corresponding angles is equal, (2) each pair of alternate interior angles is equal, (3) each pair of interior angles on same side is supplementary.
concepts.formula: parallel: corresponding = equal; alternate interior = equal; same-side interior = 180
concepts.key_idea: Parallel lines: corresponding equal, alternate equal, same-side supplementary.
question_patterns: if l parallel m find the angle
find x if l parallel m
interior angles on same side supplementary
find unknown angles p parallel q

solution_steps.explain: Determine if angles are corresponding, alternate, or same-side
Corresponding/alternate = equal. Same-side = sum to 180.
Use the relationship to find the unknown angle

concepts.title: Checking for Parallel Lines
concepts.definition: If a transversal cuts two lines such that (1) corresponding angles are equal, or (2) alternate interior angles are equal, or (3) interior angles on same side are supplementary, then the lines are parallel.
concepts.formula: equal corresponding or equal alternate or supplementary same-side => parallel
concepts.key_idea: Equal corresponding/alternate or supplementary same-side means parallel.
question_patterns: decide whether l is parallel to m

solution_steps.explain: If corresponding angles are equal, lines are parallel
If alternate interior angles are equal, lines are parallel
If same-side interior angles sum to 180, lines are parallel
If any condition holds, lines are parallel
